In globalbibletools/platform@5d4041d4, src/ui/study/components/AttributionDialog.tsx gives the glosses of every language except English New Testament the use {type: "self", licenseCode: "cc0_1_0"}, which src/messages/en.json renders as "English Glosses by Global Bible Tools are available under Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal". Only English New Testament glosses (Alan Bunning, CNTR) are "used with permission"; this is an Old Testament file, GBT's own export at the recorded commit. GBT's exporter has since skipped English, citing only the New Testament glosses' licence. The globalbibletools/data repository carries no LICENSE file; the dedication is GBT's published statement in its platform. Checked 2026-10-27 (spec-chirho/research-chirho/26-10-27-release-license-check-chirho.md).
